categories.main_business_segments: Jiangyin Haida Rubber and Plastic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in rubber and plastic products manufacturing, focusing on sealing and vibration reduction components for high-end equipment. Key segments include products for rail transit, automotive, construction, and shipping industries. The company also has a significant aluminum products segment specializing in lightweight automotive sunroof guide rails and other aluminum extrusion products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary rubber compounding and processing technologies with over 100 patents, including 24 invention patents. It employs advanced aluminum extrusion technologies such as low-temperature high-speed isothermal extrusion, mold design optimization, and automated inspection systems. Production follows a make-to-order model with specialized divisions managing customized manufacturing processes, supported by digital management systems like PLM, SRM, and MES.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include manufacturers in rail transit (e.g., high-speed trains, subways), automotive OEMs (including major domestic and international brands), construction companies for doors and windows, and shipping companies. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with growing exports especially in automotive sealing products to North America and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly based in Jiangsu Province, China, with subsidiaries and production facilities in Ningbo, Wuhan, Chongqing, and overseas investments including Romania and Singapore. The company serves domestic Chinese markets extensively and exports to Europe, North America, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing customized rubber and aluminum components for OEMs and system integrators. It procures raw materials like synthetic rubber and aluminum ingots upstream and supplies finished components downstream to vehicle manufacturers, rail transit companies, and construction firms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation in high-performance sealing and vibration reduction materials, lightweight aluminum components, and new energy sector products such as battery pack sealing systems. The company emphasizes green and low-carbon technologies, automation, digitalization, and expanding R&D collaborations with universities and research institutes. It aims to lead in high-end equipment component solutions and expand into emerging markets like hydrogen energy and energy storage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized rubber and aluminum products to OEMs and system integrators. The company follows a make-to-order production model based on signed contracts specifying technical specifications, quantities, and prices. Export sales are conducted via contracts with defined delivery and payment terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haida is positioned as a leading domestic player in rubber sealing and vibration reduction components, recognized as a top 10 company in the Chinese rubber products industry for nine consecutive years. Its aluminum extrusion subsidiary, Konno Precision, is a major specialized supplier of automotive sunroof guide rails with national-level recognition. The company competes by leveraging technology, quality, and integrated solutions to substitute imports and expand market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 2.74 billion, a 4% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 135 million, up 31%. The company has total assets of about RMB 3.6 billion and equity of RMB 2.19 billion, showing steady growth and improved profitability. R&D investment was about RMB 105 million, representing 3.83% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haida emphasizes its proprietary technology in rubber compounding and aluminum extrusion, offering high-durability, environmentally friendly, and high-performance sealing and vibration reduction solutions. Its products meet stringent industry standards and are tailored for high-end applications in rail transit, automotive, construction, and shipping. The company’s integrated multi-field technology fusion and customization capabilities provide competitive advantages in quality, cost control, and innovation.
